Export ensureContrastToward from the package (rich-palette-xovz.bfb) (#610)

* Export ensureContrastToward from the package (rich-palette-xovz.bfb)

cc-dump-web holds six category bar colors to a 3:1 floor on a theme's
background and on its surface. ensureContrast picks its pole from each
ground's own luminance, so on grounds either side of the 0.179 cutoff the
second slide undoes the first floor; ensureContrastToward takes the pole, and
slid toward the theme's text pole both floors hold. The index exports it
beside ensureContrast, docs/contrast.md shows the two side by side, and the
color studio demonstrates it, which grows its tour to 451 rows, so its card
opens at 455. colorMath is unchanged.

* ensureContrastToward's page states which floors hold, what toward names and that bg is opaque; a contract test pins it (rich-palette-xovz.bfb review)

* The page says a fallback keeps no earlier floor and may miss its own; a test pins the flip to the other pole (rich-palette-xovz.bfb review)

* One description of toward, an opaque bg as precondition, a shorter barrel line (rich-palette-xovz.bfb review)
CLAUDE.md: performance is a count of work, never a clock; load tests are banned
The unclosed-links linearity test starts at 4,000 links, so a saturated suite stays well clear of the hang limit (rich-unfiled-791c.m154)
